svg.text: backend/src/superaide/pipeline.py, Agent.handle. Every channel becomes one InboundMessage and takes the same path; the model is only called at step 4.
WHAT A STEP CAN LEAD TO
Meera, a stranger, writes to the owner's Telegram bot. Step 1 passes (the bot
token is genuine). Step 2 finds no linked person for her Telegram id, so she is
a stranger. The receptionist answers from public facts only and records a
message for the owner. No memory is read, no tool runs.
The owner asks for a digest
The owner types "give me a digest" in the DM: audience is the owner alone,
private notes are visible and tools are all available. The same words in a
shared Slack channel: the audience contains unknown people, so only public-level
notes are visible, mail and calendar tools are refused and nothing is learned.
The model proposes gmail_send. Step 5 does not send: decide() records an Approval card
sealed with a hash of the exact payload. The owner approves in the app, and only then
does the executor run, if the draft is unchanged.
